name: mod-compressor
description: Vortex extension to compress mods using Windows NTFS/WOF transparent compression (compact.exe)

scripts.build: npm run build:helper && npm run build:js
scripts.build:helper: cargo build --release --manifest-path native/mod-compressor-helper/Cargo.toml && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Copy-Item -LiteralPath native/mod-compressor-helper/target/release/mod-compressor-helper.exe -Destination native/mod-compressor-helper.exe -Force"

vortex.name: Mod Compressor
vortex.description: Compress Bethesda game mods using Windows NTFS transparent compression (compact.exe). Port of MO2's mod_compressor_tool plugin.
vortex.author: Community
